title: Tuning forks (40 Hz & C128)
summary: Why 40 Hz is the recommended session frequency, how weighted C128 (128 Hz) body-contact circuits are taught for calm / parasympathetic self-care, and how to practice intentional fork time under Vagus nerve stimulation.

sections.heading: What this habit is
sections.body: Tuning forks are metal instruments that vibrate at a fixed frequency when struck. In this lifestyle stack they are used for short, intentional sound and bone-conducted vibration sessions—not music-therapy appointments or medical devices. You need physical forks to practice the habit; phone-generated tones alone are not equivalent.

sections.heading: Recommended: 40 Hz
sections.body: Prefer a 40 Hz fork (or a short 40 Hz near-field listening session) as the default. Forty hertz sits in the gamma-band range often discussed for rhythmic sensory stimulation and focused calm. Keep sessions short and deliberate—strike, listen or place, breathe, repeat—rather than blasting sound for an hour.

sections.heading: Suggested: C128 (128 Hz) on the body
sections.body: A weighted C128 (128 Hz) “Otto-style” fork is commonly used on bone for a parasympathetic / calm-down circuit. Activate on the palm, then place the stem on: crown, forehead, mastoid behind each ear, TMJ in front of each ear, manubrium (upper sternum), xiphoid (lower sternum), and sacrum between the posterior dimples—typically three activations per spot. This matches popular instructional demos of C128 for wind-down self-care.

sections.heading: Safe basics
sections.body: Do not strike forks on hard surfaces that chip tines or injure skin. Avoid pressing hard on swollen joints, fresh injuries, or implants without clinician guidance. Stop for dizziness, ear pain, or headache. Not a treatment for anxiety disorders, endocrine disease, or neurological conditions.

sections.heading: Where Dr. Jack Kruse’s teaching is specific
sections.body: Sound and vibration tools show up in communities overlapping Kruse’s stack as evening calm practices beside darkness and phone removal—not as a core light–water–magnetism pillar equal to sun or cold. Exact frequency prescriptions (40 Hz vs C128 circuits) are largely practitioner and community culture. Keep forks as optional Support sensory hygiene.

sections.heading: What is solid, what is framework
sections.body: Solid ground: rhythmic sensory input can feel settling; short intentional rituals help wind-down behavior; physical vibration on bone is real mechanical stimulus. Framework: that 40 Hz forks treat Alzheimer’s, balance cortisol labs, or replace clinical care. This guide does not measure brain rhythms with a simple routine.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: For tuning forks, use the Tuning forks practice under Vagus nerve stimulation. Equipment is required, so skip this approach if you do not own forks. Pair with evening blue-light hygiene and phone-away-from-bed when you use forks to wind down. Educational only.
